default.notes: Eligible for a visa on arrival (MOP 100, 30 days) at Macao's border checkpoints — check the Public Security Police list before travel, as several nationalities are visa-exempt instead.

groups.notes: Visa-free for up to 30 days — confirm your exact allowance on the Public Security Police visa list before a long stay.
Not eligible for a visa on arrival — apply for a Macao entry visa in advance through a Chinese embassy or consulate.

MO.notes: Home territory — no entry requirements for Macao permanent residents.

HK.notes: Hong Kong residents enter visa-free — permanent residents can use their HK identity card (no passport needed) for visits of up to one year.

CN.notes: Mainland Chinese citizens travel on a Mainland Travel Permit with an exit endorsement issued by mainland authorities, not a Macao visa.

TW.notes: Taiwan residents enter with a valid Taiwan travel document for up to 30 days — confirm current arrangements before travel.

XK.notes: Kosovo passports are not accepted for visa-free or on-arrival entry — arrange entry documents through a Chinese diplomatic mission before travel.
